description: This file defines the ShellFeaturesManager class which implements IShellFeaturesManager interface. It manages features and extensions within the OrchardCore shell environment, providing methods to retrieve, update, and filter features and extensions based on their enabled/disabled status and validation.

classes.name: ShellFeaturesManager
classes.description: Manages shell features and extensions, providing methods to retrieve available, enabled, disabled, and always enabled features, as well as updating features and retrieving enabled extensions.

methods.name: GetAvailableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves features that are valid and available based on validation providers.

methods.name: GetEnabledFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves features currently enabled in the shell descriptor.

methods.name: GetAlwaysEnabledFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves features that are always enabled or marked as always enabled in the shell descriptor.

methods.name: GetDisabledFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves features that are disabled in the shell descriptor.

methods.name: UpdateFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Updates the set of enabled and disabled features, with an option to force the update.

methods.name: GetEnabledExtensionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves extensions that have at least one enabled feature.
